fee_details:
- 1st Year: Rs.499 + Taxes
- 2nd Year Onwards: Rs.499 + Taxes (Renewable if annual spends of Rs.2,00,000 previous year)
joining_perks: 2,000 reward points or Rs.500 instant joining fee
reward_structure:
- BPCL Petrol pumps: 4 points
- Groceries: 3 points
- Dining, movies: 2 points
- Other fuel & other purchases: 1 point
key_highlights:
- A co-branded credit card
- Offers rewards and benefits on purchases of fuel, groceries, departmental stores, dining and entertainment

benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Surcharge waiver of up to Rs.100 per month at BPCL petrol pumps anywhere in the country. Annual fuel saving of Rs.700 plus.
benefits_features.Reward points: Six reward points every Rs.100 spent on petrol, groceries, dining, movie tickets purchases and departmental store purchases. 1 reward point on every Rs.100 spent on non-fuel purchases.
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: The card comes with an annual fee of Rs.499.

how_tos.Check Eligibility: Individuals who wish to apply SBI BPCL credit card must check their eligibility first using SBI website or by contacting the SBI_Credit_Care@sbi.co.in

reward_point_benefits: 4,250 Valueback (12X points) on fuel purchases at BPCL petrol pumps. Maximum 15000 Reward Points per year cycle.

fees_and_charges.Cash advance fee:
- 2.5% of the amount withdrawn at Rs.500 (Domestic ATM)
- 2.5% of the amount withdrawn and/or Rs.500 (International ATMs)
fees_and_charges.Payment due late fee: 2% of the payment amount minimum of Rs.500
fees_and_charges.Statement request: Rs.100 per statement (more than 2 months old)
fees_and_charges.Over limit fee: 2.5% of this limit amount; minimum of Rs.500

miscellaneous:
Easy Bill Pay: Pay bills easily for utility payments.
Add-on Credit Card: Add-on cards are available for family members.
Balance Transfer: Balance transfer from other credit cards to BPCL SBI card is available with lower interest rates and easy EMI payments.
Flexipay Benefits: Transactions above Rs.2,000 can be converted into easy EMI with FlexiPay.
Other benefits: Cheque or cash against credit limit available.
Easy management of account through website and mobile apps.

faqs.What is BPCL SBI Credit Card?: A co-branded credit card issued as an SBI card. SBI card introduces SBI and Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) which offers benefits and rewards on fuel purchase as well as groceries, dining and entertainment.
faqs.Where can I apply for the BPCL SBI Credi: You can apply for the BPCL SBI Credit Card from the official website of the State Bank of India or from BankBazaar.
faqs.What is the annual fee for the BPCL SBI: The BPCL SBI Credit Card comes with an annual fee of Rs.499.
faqs.What benefits do I receive with the annu: You receive reward points waiver of up to Rs.100 per month. You can get accelerated reward points of 12x at BPCL petrol pumps along with a fuel surcharge waiver.
faqs.What is the interest charged for BPCL SB: The interest is prepaid for BPCL SBI credit card for 50 days.
faqs.Does the BPCL SBI Credit Card have any a: Yes, you can increase the purchasing power of your family members such as parents, spouse and above 18 years old by opting for the BPCL SBI credit Card's add-on facility.
faqs.What is the reward limit for BPCL SBI Cr: There is no reward limit for BPCL SBI Credit Card.
faqs.Is there a minimum threshold of reward p: No, there is no minimum threshold for reward points for redemption on the BPCL SBI Credit Card.
faqs.What are the documents needed for applyi: You will need proof of identity, PAN card, salary slip, address proof and recent passport size photograph.
faqs.How long does the bank take to process t: If all the documents submitted are in order, the bank takes 7 (seven) days to process your application for the BPCL SBI Credit Card.
